title: A generalized Prouhet–Thue–Morse divisibility conjecture
statement:
Let $m\geq 1$ and let $a_{1},\ldots,a_{k}$ be nonnegative integers. Put $A=(a_{1},\ldots,a_{k})$, $X=(x_{1},\ldots,x_{m})$, and $Y=(y_{1},\ldots,y_{m})$. Define

$$
G_{A}(X,Y)=\sum_{i_{1}=0}^{k^{a_{1}}-1}\cdots\sum_{i_{k}=0}^{k^{a_{m}}-1}\zeta_{k}^{\sum_{j=1}^{m}s_{k}(i_{j})}\Bigl(\sum_{j=1}^{m}(s_{k}(i_{j})x_{j}+i_{j}y_{j})\Bigr)^{\sum_{j=1}^{m}a_{j}}.
$$

**Generalized Prouhet–Thue–Morse divisibility conjecture.** If $k=2$, then

$$
G_{A}(X,Y)=(-1)^{\sum_{j=1}^{m}a_{j}}\Bigl(\sum_{j=1}^{m}a_{j}\Bigr)!\prod_{j=1}^{m}\prod_{i_{j}=0}^{a_{j}-1}(x_{j}+2^{i_{j}}y_{j}).
$$

If $k>2$, then

$$
\prod_{j=1}^{m}\prod_{i_{j}=0}^{n_{j}-1}(x_{j}+k^{i_{j}}y_{j})\mid G_{A}(X,Y).
$$

The conjecture is presented as a further generalization of results in the paper; the supplied text gives no resolution or supporting status evidence.
source_name: Jakub Byszewski and Maciej Ulas, “Some identities involving Prouhet-Thue-Morse sequence and its relatives”, arXiv:1409.8118 (2014).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1409.8118

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of September 2014).
